APPENDIX A 
ORDER OF THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE 
NINTH CIRCUIT DENYING INJUNCTION PENDING APPEAL, WE 
THE PATRIOTS USA, Inc., et al. v. VENTURA UNIFIED SCHOOL 
DISTRICT, et al., No. 25-5239 (C.A.9, Sept. 9, 2025). 
App.1

UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS
FOR THE NINTH CIRCUIT
WE THE PATRIOTS USA, INC. and JANE 
DOE, on her own behalf and on behalf of 
Child 1,
 Plaintiffs - Appellants,
 v.
VENTURA UNIFIED SCHOOL 
DISTRICT; et al.,
 Defendants - Appellees.
No. 25-5239
D.C. No.
2:25-cv-04659-AB-JC
Central District of California, 
Los Angeles
ORDER
Before: R. NELSON, SUNG, and H.A. THOMAS, Circuit Judges.
The motion (Docket Entry No. 15) for injunctive relief is denied. See 
Feldman v. Ariz. Sec’y of State, 843 F.3d 366, 367 (9th Cir. 2016) (“The standard 
for evaluating an injunction pending appeal is similar to that employed by district 
courts in deciding whether to grant a preliminary injunction.”); see also Winter v. 
Natural Res. Def. Council, Inc., 555 U.S. 7, 20 (2008) (defining standard for 
preliminary injunction in district court). The request for judicial notice (Docket 
Entry No. 25) is denied as moot.
The existing briefing schedule remains in effect.
FILED
SEP 9 2025
MOLLY C. DWYER, CLERK
U.S. COURT OF APPEALS
 Case: 25-5239, 09/09/2025, DktEntry: 32.1, Page 1 of 1
App.2
